usedFor: Bouncify checks whether an email address can receive mail, using “Verify Email Address” before you write to it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal” in Kylas CRM, then “Verify Email Address” in Bouncify
bestTemplate.why: A new deal brings a fresh email address, and the check finds deliverability risks before anyone writes.

watchOut: Any email sent after “Verify Email Address” still waits in Needs you for your approval.
